## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Original empirical work (consider JPSP, PSPB, JESP)
- Literature compilations without theoretical synthesis
- AI use without disclosure per SAGE policy

### Soft Tax

Moderate. Integrative-review writing demands extensive engagement with subfield literatures + mid-range theory development.

### Best Suited For

- Integrative personality / social-psychology reviews
- Mid-range theory development papers
- Cross-subfield conceptual integration
- Self, identity, cultural-psychology synthesis
- Process-model integrative reviews

### Not Recommended For

- Original empirical work (consider JPSP, PSPB, JESP)
- Pure narrative reviews without theory
- Pure qualitative work

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin](./personality-and-social-psychology-bulletin.md) | If reframed as empirical-test; SPSP family |
| 2 | [Review of General Psychology](./review-of-general-psychology.md) | APA Division 1 integrative-review peer |
| 3 | [Social and Personality Psychology Compass](./social-and-personality-psychology-compass.md) | Wiley peer for broader-audience reviews |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JPSP as "needs more theoretical integration," PSPR is the natural SPSP integrative-review home.
